# truenas_cloudsync_task (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS cloud sync task by description. Cloud sync tasks have no name field; description serves as the lookup key.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Task description to look up.

### Read-Only

- `attributes` (String)
- `credentials` (Number)
- `direction` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `exclude` (List of String)
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `include` (List of String)
- `path` (String)
- `post_script` (String)
- `pre_script` (String)
- `schedule` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedule))
- `snapshot` (Boolean)
- `transfer_mode` (String)
